# Classical intelligence controls

Ten original short MusicXML engineering examples authored for the authorized
2026-10-21 C1–C4 refinement. Distributed under the repository's MIT license.
No historical score, personal composition, external corpus or downloaded edition
was used. Names describe the intended evaluation question, not authenticated style.

Independent expected musical observations and construction changes are retained
in `docs/V0.2-classical-intelligence-evidence/expectations.md`; the source authoring
helper is beside it. Expected answers were specified from notation and rational
arithmetic, not generated by the analysis engine.

Piano upper/lower parts explicitly represent keyboard lines. This does not test
new grand-staff extraction. Violin/cello examples use concert-pitch notation.
Positive/contrast pairs cover Bach-associated contrapuntal mechanisms,
Mozart-associated designated phrases, Beethoven-associated seed development,
and broad Romantic chromatic/linear relationships. Ambiguous/unknown examples
require withheld dependent conclusions.

The retained first Romantic construction encountered an unchanged legacy seventh
validation error and is preserved in the evidence baseline, not counted as a
successful case. The final positive example uses simpler independently specified
support. These controls establish narrow operations, not historical population
accuracy or full M3/M4 acceptance.
